Package org.openxava.chat.impl

Class EntityModifyTools

java.lang.Object
org.openxava.chat.impl.BaseEntityTools
org.openxava.chat.impl.EntityModifyTools
public class EntityModifyTools extends BaseEntityTools
Tools for modifying OpenXava entity data using LangChain4j. Separated from EntityTools to allow disabling data modification via configuration.

7.7
Author:
Javier Paniza

  • Method Details

    • updateEntity

      public String updateEntity(String entity, Map<String,Object> key, Map<String,Object> values)
      Updates one or more fields of an entity. The key can be obtained from the hiddenKey field returned by findEntities methods.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity name (e.g., "Customer", "Invoice", "Product")
      key - The entity key as a Map (obtained from hiddenKey)
      values - A map with the field names and their new values
      Returns:
      A confirmation message or error description
